asset_attachments_dimensions_valid.name: asset_attachments_dimensions_valid
asset_attachments_dimensions_valid.value: ("asset_attachments"."width" is null and "asset_attachments"."height" is null) or ("asset_attachments"."width" > 0 and "asset_attachments"."height" > 0)

reminders_recurrence_fields.name: reminders_recurrence_fields
reminders_recurrence_fields.value: ("reminders"."recurrence_kind" = 'once' and "reminders"."frequency" is null and "reminders"."recurrence_interval" is null) or ("reminders"."recurrence_kind" = 'recurring' and "reminders"."frequency" is not null and "reminders"."recurrence_interval" > 0 and ("reminders"."ends_on" is not null or "reminders"."occurrence_limit" is not null))

wishlist_items_current_price_date_pair.name: wishlist_items_current_price_date_pair
wishlist_items_current_price_date_pair.value: ("wishlist_items"."current_price_minor" is null and "wishlist_items"."current_price_observed_on" is null) or ("wishlist_items"."current_price_minor" is not null and "wishlist_items"."current_price_observed_on" is not null)

wishlist_items_conversion_pair.name: wishlist_items_conversion_pair
wishlist_items_conversion_pair.value: ("wishlist_items"."status" = 'converted' and "wishlist_items"."converted_asset_id" is not null and "wishlist_items"."converted_at" is not null) or ("wishlist_items"."status" <> 'converted' and "wishlist_items"."converted_asset_id" is null and "wishlist_items"."converted_at" is null)
